mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.name AS name, m.gender AS gender, m.company AS company, m.tenure_years AS tenureYears, m.education AS education, m.biography AS biography, m.invest_style AS investStyle, m.best_return AS bestReturn, m.manage_count AS manageCount, m.total_manage AS totalManage, m.status AS status FROM fund_manager m INNER JOIN fund f ON f.manager_id = m.id WHERE f.fund_code = #{fundCode} AND f.deleted = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
